about.title: About Coachi
about.intro: Coachi is a simple app for fitness coaches in Egypt to run every client from one place, and for their clients to follow their plan and see how far they've come.

sections.title: Why we built it
sections.body: Most coaches we know run their business on WhatsApp, Excel, and PDF files. The big coaching apps are built for the US, priced in dollars, and in English. Coachi is Arabic first, priced in EGP, and made for how coaches here actually work.

sections.title: What it does
sections.body: A full file for every client, workout and meal plans, weekly check-ins, and progress for the coach. For the client: today's workout and meals, logging every set, and a journey page that keeps them going.

sections.title: Talk to us
sections.body: Coaches can reach us through the form on the home page. Clients should talk to their coach first; for anything about your account or data, message us from the same form.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This page explains what Coachi stores about you, why, and who can see it. We wrote it in plain words. If anything is unclear, ask us.

sections.title: What we store
sections.body: Your name, phone number or email, and language. If you are a client: what you write in the intake form (goal, body measurements, injuries and health notes you choose to share, food likes, your gym's equipment), your workouts, meals, weight, check-in answers, and any photos you add. If you are a coach: your public profile, your plans and templates, and your private notes about clients.

sections.title: Why we store it
sections.body: Only to run the coaching between you and your coach: building plans, logging workouts, and showing progress. We don't sell your data and we don't show ads.

sections.title: Who can see it
sections.body: A client's data is seen by the client and by their coach, plus any team member the coach assigns to them. Coach notes are private to the coach's team; the client never sees them. Progress photos are private and open only through short-lived links. The Coachi team can open an account only to help with a support request, and every such action is logged.

sections.title: Health information
sections.body: Injuries and health notes are sensitive. Share only what helps your coach plan safely. You can edit or remove them any time from your intake answers or by asking your coach.

sections.title: Where it's kept
sections.body: On our database provider's servers in Frankfurt, Germany. Data is encrypted in transit. Times are kept in UTC and shown in your time zone.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can see, download, correct, or delete your data. Clients download their data from Me; coaches download their clients' data from Settings. To delete your account, ask us through the form on the home page. These rights follow Egypt's Personal Data Protection Law (No. 151 of 2020).

sections.title: Cookies and analytics
sections.body: We keep you logged in and remember settings like language and theme on your device. We count how features are used, without selling or sharing that data, to make the app better.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: If we change this page in a way that matters, we'll tell you in the app before it applies.

terms.title: Terms
terms.intro: These terms cover using Coachi as a coach or as a client. By using the app you agree to them.

sections.title: Accounts
sections.body: You log in with a code sent to your phone or email. Keep access to them safe; anyone who can read your codes can open your account. One person per account.

sections.title: Coaches
sections.body: Coaches pay a monthly plan, by hand (InstaPay, Vodafone Cash, bank transfer, or cash). When a plan ends, the coach can still log in and see everything, but can't add clients or new plans until it's renewed. Nothing is deleted. Coaches are responsible for the advice and plans they give their clients.

sections.title: Clients
sections.body: Coachi is free for clients. Your coach decides your plans; Coachi doesn't. You can stop working with a coach any time.

sections.title: Not medical advice
sections.body: Coachi is a tool for coaching, not a medical service. Plans in the app are not medical advice. Talk to a doctor before starting a new program, especially with an injury or health condition, and stop if something hurts.

sections.title: Fair use
sections.body: Don't use Coachi to harass anyone, share content you don't have the right to share, upload other people's photos without permission, or try to access accounts that aren't yours.

sections.title: Your content
sections.body: Your data stays yours. Coaches can export their clients' data at any time, and clients can export their own. We use your content only to run the app for you.

sections.title: Availability
sections.body: We work hard to keep Coachi running and your data safe, but we can't promise it will never be down. Workouts you log offline are kept on your phone and sent when you're back online.

sections.title: Changes and law
sections.body: We may update these terms and will tell you in the app first. These terms follow the laws of Egypt.
